Key Facts

  • Product type: Pre-diluted essential oil roll-on
  • Brand: BodyJ4You
  • Volume: 10 mL (0.34 fl oz) per bottle
  • Base oil: Organic MCT coconut oil (caprylic/capric triglyceride)
  • Certification: USDA Certified Organic
  • Applicator: Natural gemstone roller ball
  • Bottle: Amber glass
  • Scents available: Rosemary, Peppermint, Castor (frankincense and castor blend), Lemon, Eucalyptus, Lavender, Tea Tree, Frankincense
  • Also: Hexane free, vegan, cruelty free, paraben free, gluten free
  • Use: External use only

What's Included

  • 1 x 10 mL amber glass bottle of the selected scent, fitted with a gemstone roller ball

Variants

  • Rosemary: Rosemary leaf oil; amethyst roller; herbal aroma for the scalp and hairline.
  • Peppermint: Peppermint oil; clear quartz roller; cool mint aroma.
  • Castor: Castor seed oil plus frankincense oil; tigerite eye roller for under-eye and face use.
  • Lemon: Lemon peel oil; yellow jade roller; bright citrus scent.
  • Eucalyptus: Eucalyptus leaf oil; fluorite roller; crisp aroma.
  • Lavender: Lavender oil; lapis lazuli roller; soft floral aroma.
  • Tea Tree: Tea tree leaf oil; clear quartz roller; for spots, cuticles and feet.
  • Frankincense: Frankincense oil; green aventurine roller; warm, earthy aroma.

Features

  • Pre-diluted and ready to use, with nothing to mix.
  • Two ingredients per bottle: one organic essential oil (two oils in the Castor option) plus organic MCT coconut oil.
  • Each scent has its own natural gemstone roller that glides on without tugging.
  • Fast absorbing, in a compact amber glass bottle.

How to Use

  • Shake gently.
  • Roll a small amount onto clean skin at the wrists, temples, neck or other pulse points.
  • Reapply during the day as the scent fades. Use once or twice daily.

Use Cases

  • Pocket-size aromatherapy roller for work, travel or the gym
  • Rosemary roller for a scalp and hairline massage routine
  • Under-eye and face roller (Castor option) as a skincare step
  • Cuticle and foot care with the Tea Tree roller
  • Meditation or yoga scent ritual

Care and Safety

  • For external use only. Avoid the eyes and mucous membranes; rinse with water if contact occurs.
  • Patch test on the inner forearm before first use. Do not use on broken or irritated skin, and stop use if irritation occurs.
  • If pregnant, nursing or under medical care, consult a medical professional before use.
  • Contains a coconut derivative (MCT oil). Store capped and out of reach.
  • Lemon: after applying citrus oil, avoid direct sun or UV exposure on that skin for 12 hours.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do the BodyJ4You essential oil roll-ons need to be diluted?

No. Each BodyJ4You roll-on is already pre-diluted in organic MCT coconut oil and is ready to apply to skin.

How much oil is in each BodyJ4You roll-on?

Each bottle holds 10 mL (0.34 fl oz) in amber glass with a gemstone roller ball.

Is the Castor option pure castor oil?

No. The Castor option is a blend of organic castor oil and frankincense oil in MCT coconut oil, with a tigerite eye roller for under-eye and face use.

Are the BodyJ4You roll-ons organic?

Yes. The roll-ons are USDA Certified Organic and are also hexane free, vegan and cruelty free.

Can I use the Lemon roll-on before going outside?

After applying the Lemon roll-on, avoid direct sun or UV exposure on that skin for 12 hours, as directed for citrus oils.

How long does a 10 mL roll-on last?

BodyJ4You states that one 10 mL bottle lasts weeks with once or twice daily use.

The BodyJ4You Organic Rosehip Oil is a single-ingredient, USDA Organic, cold pressed rosehip seed oil, bottled 100% pure and undiluted, used as a lightweight face oil and for body, hair and nails. It comes in sizes from a 5 mL bottle to a 16 fl oz bulk bottle, plus a 1.7 fl oz rose quartz roll-on.

Key Facts

  • Product type: Cold pressed rosehip seed face oil
  • Brand: BodyJ4You
  • Ingredient: Organic rosehip seed oil (Rosa rubiginosa)
  • Certification: USDA Certified Organic
  • Processing: Cold pressed, hexane free, 100% pure and undiluted, no fillers
  • Sizes: 5 mL; 1 fl oz (30 ml); 2 fl oz (60 ml); 4 fl oz (120 ml); 16 fl oz (480 ml); 1.7 fl oz (50 ml) roll-on
  • Bottle: Amber glass (dropper on 1 and 2 fl oz); rose quartz roller on the roll-on
  • Contains: Vitamin A, vitamin C and fatty acids
  • Scent: Unscented, no added fragrance
  • Also: Vegan, non-GMO, cruelty free, paraben free, alcohol free

What's Included

  • 1 x bottle of organic rosehip oil in the selected size

Variants

  • 5 mL: Smallest size.
  • 1 Fl Oz: Classic amber glass dropper for a morning and night face routine.
  • 2 Fl Oz: Amber glass dropper with enough oil for daily body massage on dry patches.
  • 4 Fl Oz: Amber glass bottle for hair, scalp, beard, cuticle and after-shower body routines.
  • 16 Fl Oz: Bulk refill for salons, spas, estheticians, carrier oil blends and soap making.
  • 1.7 Fl Oz Roll-On: Unrefined rosehip oil in a glass bottle with a rose quartz roller ball for face, under eyes and cuticles.

Features

  • One ingredient, organic rosehip seed oil, with no fillers, fragrance or additives.
  • Lightweight, fast absorbing and non-greasy.
  • Hydrates dry skin and softens the look of fine lines, dark spots and uneven tone.
  • Gentle enough for sensitive and mature skin.
  • Works under moisturizer, with a gua sha stone or as a dermaplane oil.

How to Use

  • Warm 2 to 3 drops between fingertips (or roll one or two passes).
  • Press into clean, damp skin morning and night, before heavier creams.
  • For hair, work a few drops through from mid-length to ends.

Use Cases

  • Daily face oil for a morning and night routine
  • Gua sha and dermaplane oil
  • Under-eye roller (roll-on)
  • Cuticle oil and after-shower body oil
  • Carrier oil for essential oil blends and soap making (16 fl oz)

Care and Safety

  • For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes.
  • Patch test on the inner forearm and wait 24 hours before first use. Stop use if irritation occurs.
  • Store capped, away from heat and sunlight, and out of reach.

Is BodyJ4You rosehip oil pure?

Warm 2 to 3 drops between your fingertips and press into clean, damp skin every morning and night.

Is BodyJ4You rosehip oil OK for sensitive skin?

BodyJ4You describes it as gentle enough for sensitive and mature skin. Patch test on the inner forearm first.

Which rosehip size should I choose?

Choose 1 fl oz for a face routine, 2 fl oz for body use, 4 fl oz for hair and body, 16 fl oz for salons and DIY, or the roll-on for under-eye and on-the-go use.
